Interface GameCommandVisitor

All Known Subinterfaces:
GamePhaseHandler
All Known Implementing Classes:
ActionPhase, ColorChoosingPhase, EndOfGamePhase, EndOfRoundPhase, PlacementPhase, PreEndOfRoundPhase, SetupPhase
public interface GameCommandVisitor
Visitor over the subtypes of GameCommand. Implemented by the GamePhaseHandlers: each phase overrides only the relevant commands and leaves the others to the default throw IllegalStateException defined in GamePhaseHandler.
